newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom seeks tie-up with Mannesmann Arcor.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom seeks tie-up with Mannesmann Arcor.

text.p: Japan Telecom Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it was seeking a technical tie-up with German telecommunications company Mannesmann Arcor AG.
Mannesmann Arcor is a joint venture of Mannesmann AG, German railways Deutsche Bahn, AT&T Corp, Deutsche Bank AG and the Unisource European telecom venture.
"We have started negotiations on a possible technical tie-up...but we have not reached any agreement yet," a Japan Telecom official told Reuters.
Asked if the two companies were considering a financial tie-up, the official said he could not rule out that possibility but that everything was still up in the air.

The German government said in late January that it had awarded two new public telephone operating licences to Mannesmann Arcor AG and Teleglobe GmbH as part its efforts to open up its telecommunications sector to competition next year.
The two companies will be allowed to provide basic telephone services to the public nationwide from January next year, when Deutsche Telekom AG's monopoly is abolished.
